'''Tessa Manchisco''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] officer who served in the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] during the latter stages of the [[Virgillian Civil War]].<ref name="Bakura sourcebook" /> She had green eyes and black hair that she wore, in Virgillian fashion, in six braids, three on either side of her head. She spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Durese/Legends|Durese]].<ref name="Bakura novel" />

By the end of the Civil War she had become captain of the light carrier ''[[Flurry]]'',<ref name="Bakura sourcebook" /> on which she continued to serve when the [[Virgillian Council]] joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She commanded it during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the [[Bakura Incident]], where she was killed with the rest of the ''Flurry's'' crew when the ship was destroyed.<ref name="Bakura novel" /> She received posthumous decoration for her service.<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
